# Leonard Vicencio — Digital Marketer, Social Media Manager & CRM Automation Specialist

> Leonard Vicencio (also known as Leo Vicencio) is a Philippines-based digital marketing strategist, social media manager, and CRM & automation specialist. He works remotely with US and international businesses on social media, paid ads, AI-powered creative, websites and funnels, and CRM and automation systems built in GoHighLevel and n8n. Website: https://leovicenciosmm.com

## About

Social media management is one of Leonard's core disciplines, but his work extends to the systems behind growth: paid advertising, AI-powered creative and commercials, websites and conversion funnels, and CRM and marketing automation in tools like GoHighLevel, n8n, Zapier, and Make. His work starts with the business — what's broken, what's missing, and what needs to be built. His positioning: "I don't just manage your digital presence. I build the systems behind your growth."

## Services

- Social media management and content strategy (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads)
- Digital marketing strategy, audits, and reporting
- Paid advertising and lead generation (Meta Ads, retargeting, lead capture)
- AI-powered creative production: AI commercials, short-form video and Reels, graphic design
- Website, landing page, and sales funnel development
- CRM implementation and marketing automation: GoHighLevel, n8n, Zapier, Make, HubSpot
- Business process automation and workflow design

### CRM & automation
- Lead enrichment pipeline (n8n): scrapes leads from Apollo.io, extracts LinkedIn profiles, validates emails with Mail.so, adds AI summaries, and pushes clean data to a master database
- AI assistant workflows (n8n): personal assistant, research, Zoom meeting, calendar, and email agents
- Employee onboarding and offboarding (n8n): form-triggered Google Workspace account creation, Slack provisioning, temporary password delivery, roster logging, and a full offboarding path that removes access
- Booked appointment workflow (GoHighLevel): tags the contact, removes it from lead nurture, runs a qualification survey, scores the lead, and branches into tailored email and SMS sequences with pre-appointment reminders

### AI commercials & Reels
- TradeAnchor AI Drama — AI-generated short drama series for Reels

## Core methodology

Leonard's Social Photosynthesis Framework explains growth as a connected system: Seed, AA Battery, Roots, Flower, Leads, and Sales — Visibility → Engagement → Leads → Sales, with CRM, automation, and reporting as the infrastructure underneath. The flower is the engagement stage and the signature visual of the framework.
